source_brief_reference: Create a short educational explainer video about how an AI production pipeline checks generated frames before assembly. The video should be clear, practical, and suitable for beginners.
visual_intent: Demonstrate that QA goes beyond technical checks into aesthetic judgment
composition_requirements: Show the visual QA system analyzing aesthetic criteria: composition, lighting, subject integrity, style consistency with score readouts.
camera_framing_requirements: Medium shot with QA scoring UI overlay on frame
subject_object_requirements: QA score panel with visual analysis highlights
required_assets: motion_graphics_assets: QA scoring template, sample analyzed frames
qa_criteria: scores explained visually, analysis highlights meaningful
